build_datasetrow: build a DatasetRow dataclass instance with prompt, prompt_len, and output_len fields
create_dataset_base: create a BaseDataset abstract class with from_args and load methods for benchmark datasets
compute_random_lens: compute random output token lengths within a range ratio of a full length for a given number of samples
gen_prompt: generate a random prompt of specified token length using a tokenizer vocabulary
gen_mm_prompt: generate a random multimodal prompt excluding an image pad token id from the tokenizer vocabulary
